citation: Chiba et al. 2025. Kyphotic Posture Reduces Respiratory Efficiency During Walking and Running. Cureus
protocol: Standing rest, then walking 4 km/h and running 10 km/h on a treadmill (steady), in neutral and simulated kyphotic posture; breath-by-breath measured
note: Rest is standing (posture stated), the kyphotic posture is an experimental manipulation: the neutral-posture column is the usable baseline. Paired design, n=10.
